index_conventions.active_parent_child_index: Zero-based index over all children whose parent remains active, including children excluded by static constraints.
index_conventions.live_child_index: Zero-based index over children that survive the parent closures, minimum-distance clauses, and matching constraint.
index_conventions.non_drat_child_index: Zero-based index after removing checked third-word DRAT parent closures but before maximum-degree closures.
index_conventions.parent_orbit_index: Zero-based descriptor-order index within one parent.
index_conventions.stage1_child_index: Zero-based index over all stage-1 third-word children.
